AUDIT: PASS
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'sweep-adopt-veridian-scripts-79-feat-ocid-020-gtm-category-5-ui-testing' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  PROGRESS.md                  |  41 ++++++++
 gtm_check_e2e_testing.py     | 180 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 gtm_check_ui_testing.py      | 242 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 gtm_write_category_result.py | 120 +++++++++++++++++++++
 4 files changed, 583 insertions(+)
Evidence Recorded: This diff adds three new, self-contained scripts (gtm_check_ui_testing.py, gtm_check_e2e_testing.py, gtm_write_category_result.py) plus a PROGRESS.md entry for OCID-020 GTM certification categories 5 and 6; it is purely additive (no existing file is modified beyond an append to PROGRESS.md), touches no .github/workflows/**, no migrations/schema/*.sql, no auth/permission/payment/billing/rls paths, and no .env files, so the tier1 classification is correct. The check scripts are well-engineered: subprocess calls use argument lists (no shell=True, no injection risk), the UI-testing probe explicitly and verifiably never calls .fill()/.type()/.click() on the live projexa-ai.com login/signup pages (inspection-only via isVisible()/isEnabled()/count()), temp probe files are cleaned up in a finally block, and both scripts have a clear, honest pass/fail/blocked distinction with real evidence (Playwright JSON stats, per-control DOM state) rather than narrative claims. The shared writer reuses superboss-register.py's existing _connect()/_write_lock() locking discipline and parameterized SQL rather than raw string-built queries, consistent with the established migrate_2026-08-05_gtm_certification_categories.py pattern, and correctly avoids any reference to the quarantined file_inventory table. Issues found: gtm_check_e2e_testing.py defines REPORT_PATH and deletes any pre-existing file at that path, but the script never writes to or reads from REPORT_PATH (it parses stdout directly instead) -- vestigial/dead code that should be removed or wired up for clarity.; gtm_write_category_result.py is documented as 'the canonical writer' for all future gtm_check_*.py scripts (its own usage example uses a generic category_index=2), but it hardcodes ocid_number="OCID-020" and umr_id="UMR-20260802-165606-4413" for every call -- correct for this task's categories today, but will silently mis-attribute audit events if reused for a different OCID/UMR certification round without updating those constants.; gtm_check_ui_testing.py makes live outbound HTTP requests to the production public site https://projexa-ai.com on every run; this is read-only and avoids credential entry per its own documented rule, but repeated automated runs against a live production domain could be flaky or draw rate-limiting/monitoring attention over time -- worth a follow-up note if this check is run frequently in CI.
Severity Classified: none
Verdict: pass
Corrective Action Owner: Not required -- no issues found in this review.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Not required -- approved as-is, no follow-up needed.
